text: TileCache budget is measured in bytes on disk (TileDao.sumBytes()), not tile count; tiles range from 4 to 60 KB.
Tile unit tests: ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests 'com.trailmark.maps.tiles.*' (Robolectric, no emulator needed).
Room migration tests are instrumented: ./gradlew :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest with an emulator running; they read the exported app/schemas/*.json.
Offline map tiles are cached in context.cacheDir so Android can clear them under storage pressure.
Offline tiles live in filesDir/tiles since v3.4 (the OS kept wiping downloaded regions from cacheDir); eviction is our job now.
TileDownloadWorker is a CoroutineWorker and must call setForeground() for offline map downloads over 50 tiles.
Since work-runtime 2.10 TileDownloadWorker is enqueued as expedited work; override getForegroundInfo() instead of calling setForeground().
Format Kotlin with ./gradlew ktlintFormat before committing.
Formatting is Spotless + ktfmt now: ./gradlew spotlessApply. The ktlint plugin was removed.
Room schema JSONs in app/schemas/ are committed; bump the AppDatabase version and add its Migration in the same commit.
StatFs and file size walks are disk I/O: run them on Dispatchers.IO. Debug builds enable StrictMode and crash on main-thread reads.
Large downloads must use NetworkType.UNMETERED unless the user enabled 'Allow mobile data'; Play review flagged this once.
Workers get dependencies via @HiltWorker + HiltWorkerFactory; the default WorkManager initializer is removed in the manifest.
Map style JSON for dark mode is app/src/main/assets/styles/dark.json; designers edit it in Maputnik, don't hand-edit.
Avatar images use Coil's disk cache (50 MB cap); Settings > Debug > Clear image cache wipes it.
GPX export (com.trailmark.export) writes timestamps as ISO-8601 UTC; Strava rejects local offsets.
Play Billing test purchases only work for accounts listed as license testers in the Play Console.
ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION must be requested at runtime on API 29+ before the step counter starts a hike.
Compose previews of HikeSummary need @PreviewParameter(HikeSampleProvider::class); real ViewModels crash the preview.
Conventional Commits with scopes: tiles, db, hike, billing, export, deps.
Release: bump versionCode/versionName in app/build.gradle.kts and add a CHANGELOG.md entry; merges to main ship to the internal track.
Library versions live only in gradle/libs.versions.toml; never hardcode a version in a build.gradle.kts.
Setup: JDK 17, copy local.properties.example to local.properties and add MAPTILER_KEY.
detekt runs in CI with maxIssues=0; suppress only with @Suppress plus a ticket link in a comment.
